points.description: States that the Euler tour traversal is a walk around the tree that starts at the root (traverses the whole tree by walking around it).
points.partial_credit: Half if it says it is a walk/traversal around the tree but does not say it starts at the root (or vice versa).

points.description: States that each node is visited/seen three times during the walk.
points.partial_credit: Half if it says nodes are visited multiple times without stating three.

points.description: Names the three visits precisely: from the left (before the left subtree / preorder-like), from below (between subtrees / inorder-like), and from the right (after the right subtree / postorder-like).
points.partial_credit: Half if two of the three visits are correctly named; none if any is wrong.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all three elements stated precisely: a walk around the tree starting at the root, each node seen three times, and the three visits being left, below, right. Part marks only where clearly more than half of a point is stated, as set out in each point. Vague answers (e.g. just "visits all nodes", or naming only preorder/inorder/postorder without the three-visits-per-node idea) earn nothing for the affected point, and a wrong count or wrong visit names loses that point.
